question_text: Explain how an automatic home heating control system could help maintain safe room temperature for a vulnerable resident.
adaptation_rationale: Retains sensor/processor/output reasoning; does not make ambient-intelligence architecture orunspecifiedMLalgorithmsmandatory.
solution: Temperature sensor repeatedly measures the room.; Controller compares readings with a safe target/range.; Actuator switches heating/cooling as required.; New readings provide feedback so the system corrects deviations; appropriate alerts can notify caregivers when normal control fails.
